Claim (technical, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): All Plutus built-in functions, including newly introduced ones, will become available across Plutus V1, V2, and V3, expanding capabilities of existing V1 and V2 scripts.
Claim (technical, proposer_asserted, medium materiality): UPLC case expressions over Bool, Integer, and Data will provide significant performance improvements and cleaner script logic.

Claim (technical, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The upgrade promotes VRF key hash uniqueness to a ledger-level predicate so no two stake pools can register or operate with the same VRF key.

Claim (technical, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The proposal states that testing reports demonstrate no behavioral regressions, complete conformance between specification and implementation for new ledger rules, and correct operation of new Plutus primitives and case expressions across Plutus V1, V2, and V3.
